description.value: Koko Monk is an internationally recognized artisan chocolate boutique open since 2013 on Vancouver's West Broadway, celebrated for its signature Harem A La Turca hot chocolate and listed among the world's top 20 chocolate companies. The shop specializes in raw, organic, vegan bean-to-bar chocolate crafted from single-origin cacao with no refined additives, alongside hand-made bonbons, small-batch gelatos, and theatrical drinking chocolates. It's a distinctive sweet stop for cyclists passing through Kitsilano, with award-winning creations regularly featured in international media.
